description: Lists the public events listed on Zonori in a place, between two local days within the next 7 days, earliest first. Each has its start time and time zone, venue, area, how many are going, who runs it and a link to its Zonori page.

place.description: A place's name or slug from list_places, e.g. Bangkok or bangkok

to.description: Last local day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days on)
